meaning.en: Day and night without rest.
meaning.zh: 不分白天黑夜，形容连续不停。

examples.zh: 为了赶工期，工人们没日没夜地干。
examples.en: To meet the deadline, the workers toiled day and night.

examples.zh: 她没日没夜地照顾生病的母亲。
examples.en: She looked after her sick mother round the clock.

examples.zh: 他没日没夜地打游戏，成绩一落千丈。
examples.en: He played video games non-stop, and his grades plummeted.

usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“没日没夜地……”。

meaning.en: On seeing a worthy person, to strive to become their equal.
meaning.zh: 看到德才兼备的人，就想向他看齐。

examples.zh: 我们要见贤思齐，向身边的榜样学习。
examples.en: We should emulate the role models around us.

examples.zh: 见贤思齐，才能不断进步。
examples.en: Only by learning from the best can you keep improving.

story.en: Confucius: 'When you see a worthy person, think of becoming their equal; when you see an unworthy one, examine yourself within.'
story.zh: 《论语》：“见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也。”

synonyms: 择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之

meaning.en: Under tight security; heavily guarded.
meaning.zh: 防备得非常严密。

examples.zh: 峰会期间，会场周围戒备森严。
examples.en: During the summit, security around the venue was tight.

examples.zh: 银行金库戒备森严。
examples.en: The bank vault is heavily guarded.

natural: all sorts of weird and wonderful

meaning.en: All kinds of strange and unusual things.
meaning.zh: 形容各种各样奇奇怪怪的事物或现象。

examples.zh: 海底有许多千奇百怪的生物。
examples.en: There are all kinds of weird and wonderful creatures on the seabed.

examples.zh: 孩子们的问题千奇百怪。
examples.en: Children ask all sorts of odd questions.

examples.zh: 溶洞里的石头形状千奇百怪。
examples.en: The rocks in the cave come in all sorts of bizarre shapes.

meaning.en: To drop one's guard through carelessness.
meaning.zh: 思想松懈，粗心大意，失去警惕。

examples.zh: 安全生产不能有半点麻痹大意。
examples.en: When it comes to workplace safety, there's no room for complacency.

examples.zh: 比分领先后，球队麻痹大意，被对手扳平。
examples.en: Once ahead, the team let their guard down and conceded an equaliser.

usage.en: Predicate or object; common in safety warnings.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，安全提醒中常用。

antonyms: 帝国主义亡我之心不死

meaning.en: Highest of all; supreme.
meaning.zh: 高到了顶点，没有更高的了。

examples.zh: 宪法具有至高无上的权威。
examples.en: The constitution has supreme authority.

examples.zh: 对他来说，家庭是至高无上的。
examples.en: For him, family comes above everything.

examples.zh: 奥运金牌是运动员至高无上的荣誉。
examples.en: An Olympic gold medal is an athlete's highest honour.

usage.en: Attributive; often 至高无上的权力/荣誉.
usage.zh: 多作定语，常说“至高无上的权力/荣誉”。

meaning.en: Every blade of grass and every tree; every little thing in a place.
meaning.zh: 每一棵草、每一棵树，比喻极其细小的东西或某地的一切。

examples.zh: 家乡的一草一木都让我怀念。
examples.en: I miss every blade of grass in my hometown.

examples.zh: 爱护校园的一草一木。
examples.en: Take care of every plant on campus.

usage.en: Usually object or subject with 的.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、主语，常说“……的一草一木”。

meaning.en: Walls of bronze and iron; an impregnable defence.
meaning.zh: 比喻十分坚固、不可摧毁的防御或事物。

examples.zh: 球队的后防线如同铜墙铁壁。
examples.en: The team's back line is like a wall of steel.

examples.zh: 军民团结如一人，筑成铜墙铁壁。
examples.en: The army and people stood united as one impregnable wall.

usage.en: Object or predicate; often 筑成/如同铜墙铁壁.

literal: diligent · diligent · in order to · seek

meaning.en: To pursue something with tireless diligence.
meaning.zh: 勤奋不懈地追求。

examples.zh: 这是他一生孜孜以求的目标。
examples.en: This is the goal he pursued tirelessly all his life.

examples.zh: 科学家们对真理孜孜以求。
examples.en: Scientists strive relentlessly for the truth.

meaning.en: To weep bitterly in each other's arms (from grief or overwhelming emotion).
meaning.zh: 互相抱着头痛哭，形容极度悲伤或激动。

examples.zh: 失散多年的兄弟重逢，抱头痛哭。
examples.en: The long-lost brothers were reunited and wept in each other's arms.

examples.zh: 输掉决赛后，队员们抱头痛哭。
examples.en: After losing the final, the players sobbed in each other's arms.

meaning.en: To change outdated customs and habits.
meaning.zh: 改变旧的风俗习惯。

examples.zh: 农村提倡移风易俗，婚事从简。
examples.en: Rural areas are encouraging reform of customs, with simpler weddings.

examples.zh: 移风易俗需要时间。
examples.en: Changing social customs takes time.

story.en: The Classic of Filial Piety: 'For changing manners and customs, nothing is better than music.'

usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常见于公文。

meaning.en: To regret something when it is too late.
meaning.zh: 事后悔恨也来不及了。

examples.zh: 现在不努力，将来会追悔莫及。
examples.en: If you don't work hard now, you'll regret it when it's too late.

examples.zh: 酒后驾车，一旦出事就追悔莫及。
examples.en: Drink-drive and have an accident, and no amount of regret will undo it.

synonyms: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲

meaning.en: To have long enjoyed a great reputation.
meaning.zh: 长期享有很大的名声。

examples.zh: 这家老字号久负盛名。
examples.en: This old brand has long been renowned.

examples.zh: 杭州的西湖久负盛名。
examples.en: Hangzhou's West Lake has long been famous.

meaning.en: Sarcastic jeers and biting ridicule.
meaning.zh: 尖刻的嘲笑和讥讽。

examples.zh: 面对同事的冷嘲热讽，他毫不在意。
examples.en: He shrugged off his colleagues' snide remarks.

examples.zh: 别对孩子冷嘲热讽，要多鼓励。
examples.en: Don't sneer at children; encourage them.

meaning.en: To flood and cause disaster; (fig.) to spread unchecked.
meaning.zh: 河水泛滥造成灾害，比喻坏的事物到处蔓延。

examples.zh: 网络谣言泛滥成灾。
examples.en: Online rumours are running rampant.

examples.zh: 雨季时这条河常常泛滥成灾。
examples.en: In the rainy season the river often floods disastrously.

examples.zh: 共享单车一度泛滥成灾。
examples.en: At one point shared bikes were everywhere, completely out of hand.

meaning.en: To charge about recklessly.
meaning.zh: 乱冲乱撞，蛮横无忌。

examples.zh: 一辆货车在街上横冲直撞。
examples.en: A lorry careered wildly down the street.

examples.zh: 孩子们在商场里横冲直撞。
examples.en: The children were running amok in the shopping centre.

meaning.en: Smugly pleased with oneself.
meaning.zh: 形容自以为很好而得意的样子。

examples.zh: 取得一点成绩就沾沾自喜，是不行的。
examples.en: It won't do to get smug over a small success.

examples.zh: 他为自己的小聪明沾沾自喜。
examples.en: He was very pleased with his own cleverness.

story.en: Emperor Jing explained to his mother why he would not make Dou Ying, Marquis of Weiqi, chancellor: 'He is just smugly pleased with himself' (沾沾自喜耳).
story.zh: 《史记》：“魏其者，沾沾自喜耳，多易。”

meaning.en: Vivid and full of life (of characters or writing).
meaning.zh: 比喻文学作品内容充实、形象生动。

examples.zh: 小说里的人物有血有肉。
examples.en: The characters in the novel feel real and three-dimensional.

examples.zh: 这篇报道写得有血有肉。
examples.en: The report is vivid and full of life.

meaning.en: (Of flowers etc.) to vie with each other in beauty.
meaning.zh: 竞相展示奇异和艳丽，多形容百花盛开。

examples.zh: 春天，公园里百花争奇斗艳。
examples.en: In spring, the flowers in the park vie with one another in beauty.

examples.zh: 车展上各款新车争奇斗艳。
examples.en: At the motor show, new models competed to dazzle.

meaning.en: In a daze; absent-minded.
meaning.zh: 神志不清，心神不定。

examples.zh: 熬了一夜，他第二天精神恍惚。
examples.en: After staying up all night, he was in a daze the next day.

examples.zh: 她精神恍惚，差点闯了红灯。
examples.en: She was so out of it she nearly ran a red light.

meaning.en: Twisted roots and gnarled knots; complicated and deeply entrenched.
meaning.zh: 树根盘绕，枝节交错，比喻事情繁难复杂或势力根深蒂固。

examples.zh: 这里的利益关系盘根错节。
examples.en: The vested interests here are deep-rooted and tangled.

examples.zh: 老槐树的根盘根错节。
examples.en: The old locust tree's roots are twisted and gnarled.

examples.zh: 要清除盘根错节的腐败网络并非易事。
examples.en: Rooting out an entrenched web of corruption is no easy task.

story.en: When Yu Xu was sent to a troubled district, he said: 'Without meeting coiled roots and tangled knots, how can one tell a sharp blade?'
story.zh: 《后汉书》：虞诩曰：“不遇盘根错节，何以别利器乎？”

meaning.en: To launch large-scale construction (often extravagantly).
meaning.zh: 大规模地兴建土木工程，多含贬义。

examples.zh: 有些地方政府大兴土木，建豪华办公楼。
examples.en: Some local governments have gone on a building spree, putting up lavish offices.

examples.zh: 城市正在大兴土木，到处都是工地。
examples.en: The city is undergoing a construction boom; there are building sites everywhere.

natural: tears streaming down an old face

meaning.en: An old person's tears streaming down their face.
meaning.zh: 老人泪流满面，形容极其悲伤或激动。

equivalents: tears streaming down one's aged face

examples.zh: 见到失散多年的儿子，老人老泪纵横。
examples.en: Seeing his long-lost son, the old man wept openly.

examples.zh: 说起往事，奶奶不禁老泪纵横。
examples.en: Talking about the past, Grandma couldn't hold back her tears.

natural: pull the wool over people's eyes

meaning.en: To deceive openly and get away with it.
meaning.zh: 用欺骗的手段暗中行动。

equivalents: pull the wool over people's eyes

examples.zh: 他想用假账瞒天过海，最后还是被查出来了。
examples.en: He tried to fool everyone with false accounts but was found out in the end.

examples.zh: 走私团伙企图瞒天过海。
examples.en: The smuggling gang tried to slip past the authorities.

story.en: The first of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: hide your real move inside routine activity everyone has stopped noticing.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第一计：“备周则意怠，常见则不疑。”

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

meaning.en: Lost to all reason and conscience; utterly depraved.
meaning.zh: 丧失理智，像发了疯一样，形容言行荒谬或残忍到了极点。

examples.zh: 歹徒丧心病狂，竟对儿童下手。
examples.en: The thugs were utterly depraved, even attacking children.

examples.zh: 这种丧心病狂的行为必须严惩。
examples.en: Such monstrous behaviour must be severely punished.
